# Municipal Ordinance No. 07, Series of 2016

**An Ordinance Authorizing the Municipal Mayor and/or the Presiding Officer of the Sanggunian to Use Savings for Augmentation in Accordance with the Local Government Code of 1991**

## Summary

Authorizes the Municipal Mayor and/or the Presiding Officer of the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] to use savings for augmentation of budget items in accordance with [[Sec-336-RA7160]] of the Local Government Code of 1991. This is a recurring authorization ordinance, with similar versions enacted as [[MO-13-S2017]] and [[MO-11-S2018]].

Presiding Officer during session: [[Esperanza A. Tan]] (Acting). Absent: [[Dexter L. Sayat]] (Vice Mayor).

## Key Provisions

- **Authorization to Use Savings:** Grants the Municipal Mayor and/or Presiding Officer authority to use savings from appropriated items for augmentation
- **Augmentation Purpose:** Allows reallocation of savings to supplement budget items that may be insufficient
- **Legal Compliance:** Ensures compliance with Section 336 of RA 7160

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]]
- [[Municipality of Pitogo]]
- [[Paulino S. Sayat]] — Municipal Mayor
- [[Esperanza A. Tan]] — Acting Presiding Officer
- [[Dexter L. Sayat]] — Vice Mayor (Absent)
